::: {.myoverbox .vlow}

exercise: how to split addresses?

:::

### solution {.smaller}

*  $4 = 2^b$ byte block size
*  $b = 2$ (block) offset bits
*  $S = 4 = 2^s$ sets
*  $s = 2$ (set) index bits
*  $m = 8$ bit addresses
*  $t = m - (s+b) = 4$ tag bits
